pack.minecraftpp.generated.title: Minecraft++ generated content
minecraftpp.world.wrong_seed.title: Wrong Minecraft++ seed
minecraftpp.world.wrong_seed.message: This world was created with the Minecraft++ seed %1$s, not with the seed of this game: its ores would change. To play it, write "seed=%1$s" in config/minecraftpp/MppConfig.mpp and restart the game.
minecraftpp.world.unreadable_seed.messag: The Minecraft++ seed of this world cannot be read from its mppSeed.mpp file. Restore this file to play the world.
minecraftpp.world.vanilla.title: Vanilla world
minecraftpp.world.vanilla.message: This world was created without Minecraft++. Do not open it with Minecraft++, or it will not be playable in vanilla anymore.
